cast.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
cast.overview: Returning for his fifth year at Hogwarts, Harry is stunned to find that his warnings about the return of Lord Voldemort have been ignored. Left with no choice, Harry takes matters into his own hands, training a small group of motivated students to defend themselves against the Dark Arts.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
cast.overview: After his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools in the Triwizard Tournament. But if Harry never submitted his name for the Tournament, then who did? Nevertheless, Harry must confront a deadly dragon, fierce water monsters, and an enchanted maze—only to find himself in the cruel grasp of He Who Must Not Be Named.

cast.title: The Tale of Despereaux
cast.overview: Once upon a time... in the far away kingdom of Dor... lived a brave and virtuous mouse with comically oversized ears who dreamt of becoming a knight. Banished from his home for having such lofty ambitions, Despereaux sets off on an amazing adventure with his good-hearted rat friend Roscuro, who leads him, at long last, on a very noble quest to rescue an endangered princess and save an entire kingdom from darkness.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
cast.overview: As Lord Voldemort tightens his grip on both the Muggle and wizarding worlds, Hogwarts is no longer a safe haven. Harry suspects perils may even lie within the castle, but Dumbledore is more intent upon preparing him for the final battle fast approaching. Even as the decisive showdown looms, romance blossoms for Harry, Ron, Hermione and their classmates. Love is in the air, but danger lies ahead and Hogwarts may never be the same again

cast.title: Ballet Shoes
cast.overview: An unusual explorer named Gum and his kindly niece adopt three orphans -- Pauline, Petrova and Posy -- and raise them as sisters in 1930s London. But the girls must fend for themselves when Gum doesn't return from one of his adventures. Together, they nurture their passions for acting, aviation and ballet in this charming TV adaptation of Noel Streatfield's novel.

cast.title: The Magic Touch of Harry Potter
cast.original_title: The Magic Touch of Harry Potter
cast.overview: A 2004 documentary on the first three “Harry Potter” films detailing the behind-the-scenes journey of making them.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
cast.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
cast.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.

cast.title: Harry Potter 20th Anniversary: Return to Hogwarts
cast.original_title: Harry Potter 20th Anniversary: Return to Hogwarts
cast.overview: An enchanting making-of story told through all-new in-depth interviews and cast conversations, inviting fans on a magical first-person journey through one of the most beloved film franchises of all time.

cast.title: An Audience with Adele
cast.overview: Joining multi-Grammy Award winning and one of the biggest UK artists of all time, Adele, for a unique and special night at the legendary London Palladium, where she performs her chart-topping single Easy On Me, as well as tracks from her new album, 30.

cast.title: The Children's Party at the Palace
cast.original_title: The Children's Party at the Palace
cast.overview: To celebrate her 80th birthday, the Queen is holding a children's party in the grounds of Buckingham Palace. She has invited many classic characters from British children's literature. But when the baddies, led by Cruella de Vil, discover that they have not been invited, they steal the Queen's handbag containing her spectacles and the text of her speech; without it, the Queen will not be able to make a speech at the party. Can the goodies find the handbag in time?

cast.title: (K)nox: The Rob Knox Story
cast.overview: A young actor is stabbed to death just days after filming his big break in the Harry Potter franchise.

cast.title: When Harry Left Hogwarts
cast.overview: BAFTA award-winning filmmaker Morgan Matthews was given unprecedented access to the behind-the-scenes of the final days of the final two Harry Potter films, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows 1 and 2. Hear the personal stories of the faces we know, and those we don't, as we come to the end of one of the most successful eras in cinema history.  Special feature on select editions of Deathly Hallows 1 & 2.

cast.title: My Week with Marilyn
cast.overview: London, 1956. Genius actor and film director Laurence Olivier is about to begin the shooting of his upcoming movie, premiered in 1957 as The Prince and the Showgirl, starring Marilyn Monroe. Young Colin Clark, who dreams on having a career in movie business, manages to get a job on the set as third assistant director.

cast.title: Noah
cast.overview: A man who suffers visions of an apocalyptic deluge takes measures to protect his family from the coming flood.

cast.title: The Bling Ring
cast.overview: Lured by stardom, a crew of aimless teens breaks into celebrity homes for a string of high-profile robberies and fame by appropriation.

cast.title: This Is the End
cast.overview: While attending a party at James Franco's house, Seth Rogen, Jay Baruchel and many other celebrities are faced with the apocalypse.

cast.title: Daniel Radcliffe: Being Harry Potter
cast.overview: Made-for-television documentary about Daniel Radcliffe and his role as Harry Potter.

cast.title: Regression
cast.overview: Minnesota, 1990. Detective Bruce Kenner investigates the case of young Angela, who accuses her father, John Gray, of an unspeakable crime. When John unexpectedly and without recollection admits guilt, renowned psychologist Dr. Raines is brought in to help him relive his memories and what they discover unmasks a horrifying nationwide mystery.

cast.title: Howard
cast.overview: Though legendary lyricist Howard Ashman died far too young, his impact on Broadway, movies, and the culture at large were incalculable. Told entirely through rare archival footage and interviews with Ashman’s family, friends, associates, and longtime partner Bill Lauch, Howard is an intimate tribute to a once-in-a-generation talent and a rousing celebration of musical storytelling itself.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
cast.overview: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
cast.overview: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

cast.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
cast.original_title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
cast.overview: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, 1991. High school freshman Charlie is a wallflower, always watching life from the sidelines, until two senior students, Sam and her stepbrother Patrick, become his mentors, helping him discover the joys of friendship, music and love.

cast.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
cast.original_title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
cast.overview: Year three at Hogwarts means new fun and new challenges as Harry learns the delicate art of approaching a Hippogriff, transforming shape-shifting Boggarts into hilarity and even turning back time. But the term also brings danger: soul-sucking Dementors hover over the school, an ally of the accursed He-Who-Cannot-Be-Named lurks within the castle walls, and fearsome wizard Sirius Black escapes Azkaban. And Harry will confront them all.

cast.title: Pickled
cast.overview: A new sport will get its close-up with a tournament of all-star teams battling it out for charity and a chance to win the coveted Golden Gherkin.

cast.title: The Circle
cast.overview: A young tech worker takes a job at a powerful Internet corporation, quickly rises up the company's ranks, and soon finds herself in a perilous situation concerning privacy, surveillance and freedom. She comes to learn that her decisions and actions will determine the future of humanity.

cast.title: Colonia
cast.original_title: Colonia Dignidad – Es gibt kein Zurück
cast.overview: A young woman's desperate search for her abducted boyfriend draws her into the infamous Colonia Dignidad, a sect nobody ever escaped from.

cast.title: Beauty and the Beast
cast.overview: A live-action adaptation of Disney's version of the classic tale of a cursed prince and a beautiful young woman who helps him break the spell.

cast.title: 50 Greatest Harry Potter Moments
cast.overview: To mark the release two weeks ago of the eighth and final movie in the series, Robbie Coltrane narrates a countdown of the movie franchise's best moments. From Harry's first meeting with Ron and Hermione aboard the Hogwarts Express through to magical mysteries.

cast.title: Little Women
cast.overview: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

cast.title: J.K. Rowling - Harry Potter and Me
cast.original_title: J.K. Rowling - Harry Potter and Me
cast.overview: J.K. Rowling - Harry Potter and Me is a landmark 2001 BBC television documentary in which creator J.K. Rowling discussed the origins of the series. It famously revealed her handwritten character notes, plot drafts, and original Hogwarts house rosters

crew.title: The Million Dollar Nickel
crew.overview: When a young woman discovers a valuable coin, she embarks on an exciting adventure to keep it out of the wrong hands and survive.
